memories.content: Yep, I read that book and loved it! It made me think about life and how important it is to follow one's dreams. Highly recommend it!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Glad you liked it! "The Alchemist" is worth it.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! Take care!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Have fun! Take care and talk to you soon.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Hey John! Awesome catchin' up with you! A lot's changed since last time. [image: a photo of a bookcase filled with dvds and games]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Hey, Tim! Good to hear from you. Anyway, a lot has been going on with me. My girlfriend and I had an amazing and emotional wedding ceremony last week. [image: a photo of a wedding ceremony in a greenhouse with people taking pictures]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Congrats! That was such a special day! How did you manage to have the ceremony during these times?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! We were lucky to find a lovely greenhouse venue for a smaller, more intimate gathering. We made sure to follow the necessary safety protocols and ensure that everyone felt safe. It was wonderful to have our loved ones celebrate with us.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Awesome! It sounds like you found a great venue and had your loved ones celebrate with you. Weddings are definitely full of joy!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yeah! Such a great day! It was so beautiful having everyone celebrating with us. I'd never felt so much love and happiness before. Some of my hiking club friends came even though I just joined!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow! Your wedding day must've been so special. Love sure does bring us joy, huh? Any favorite memories from the big day?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Oh yeah! Picking a favorite memory was tough, but seeing her walking down the aisle, her face lit up and it got me all choked up. What a magical moment - one I'll always remember. [image: a photography of a bride walking down the aisle with her groom]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: I bet that moment was unreal! One moment can make such an impression. I saw your photo of you two dancing, it must have been incredible. Wanna tell me more? [image: a photo of a desk with a bookcase full of books and a lot of other items]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: That dance was great! We had our first dance at a cozy restaurant. It was so dreamy with the music and candlelight. We were so lucky to have everyone with us!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow, a candlelit dance in a cozy restaurant! Sounds like a fairytale! So special to share with your loved ones. Weddings truly are the best!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! It was a great day. Having everyone there made it extra special. It's moments like these that bring love and joy.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Congrats again! Love is truly magical and brings so much joy. I'm so happy for you and your new wife!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks so much! Your words mean a lot. I'm lucky to have you in my life, bringing so much love and joy.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Thanks. Your friendship means a lot to me. I'm here for you anytime. I also wanted to share this bookshelf with you. It's filled with my favorite fantasy novels. [image: a photo of a bookcase filled with dvds and games]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Cool! What do you enjoy about them so much?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: They really fire up my imagination and take me to alternate realities. They're my escape from reality.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: That's great Tim! Books and movies make us escape to different places. I like to collect jerseys. [image: a photo of a bunch of basketball jerseys laying on a bed]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Cool! Who's your favorite basketball team/player?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! The Wolves are my team for sure. And LeBron is the man - love his skills and leadership.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: The Wolves are solid and LeBron's skills and leadership are amazing.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: I really admire his work ethic and dedication to the game, such an inspiration. [image: a photo of a group of people standing on a basketball court]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: LeBron is incredible. Have you ever had the opportunity to meet him or see him play live?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yeah, I've had the chance to meet him a few times. He's real chill and it was a wild experience. I also had the opportunity to see him play live. It was tough, but I learned a lot from watching a top player like him.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow! Meeting him and seeing him play must've been awesome. I can only imagine his skills up close. [image: a photo of a crowd of people at a concert with their hands in the air]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: It was so amazing! The energy was crazy and everyone was so hyped. Seeing the top players was so motivating - it made me want to work even harder. Check out this pic from the game! [image: a photo of a basketball game with a crowd of people watching]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That crowd looks wild! The game must've been amazing!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: The energy was incredible! It's moments like these that make me love my job.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Cool! It's great to find something you enjoy doing. Keep going for it! See ya later!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Hey John! It's been ages since we last talked. Guess what? Last week I went to a Harry Potter conference in the UK - it was incredible! There were so many people who shared the same love of HP as me, it was like a magical family. I felt so inspired and like I got a new lease of life. I love how my passion for fantasy stuff brings me closer to people from all over the world, it's pretty cool.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Hey Tim! Great to hear from you. It's awesome how our passions connect us with others, yeah? You sound like you fit right in and got a real buzz out of it. I feel the same way with my team. [image: a photography of a basketball team posing for a team photo]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow, you guys look great! How have games been going?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: It was an intense season with both tough losses and great wins. Overall, I'd say we did pretty well.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Cool! Sounds like you guys had some tough games. How did you handle those?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! We faced tough opponents but that's what drives us to get better. We back each other up and won't quit. [image: a photo of a soccer team posing for a picture with a trophy]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Congrats! That's awesome. It must feel good, right?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yeah, it feels great! All that hard work and effort was totally worth it. We even won a trophy! [image: a photo of a man holding a trophy in front of a crowd]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Way to go! You must have been elated up there with that trophy. All the hard work paid off! Congrats - I'm so proud of you. Keep it up!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! I was definitely elated. Your support really means a lot to me. I'll keep working hard.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: No problem! I'm here for you anytime. Keep believing in yourself!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! Appreciate your support. Always staying filled with self-belief.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: You got this! Stay motivated and remember that anything is possible with hard work. Keep pushing for your goals! [image: a photo of a box of serenityy memory foam]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! Your encouragement means a lot to me. I'm feeling motivated and ready to keep pushing for my goals! I'm going to need some new shoes after all these games though.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Glad my encouragement helped! These are amazing - like walking on clouds! Game changer! [image: a photo of a pair of black and pink running shoes]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: They look comfortable. Where did you get them?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: I got them online - they're super comfy! Definitely recommend!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Cheers! I'll definitely check them out. Thanks for the recommendation!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: No worries. Let me know if there's anything else I can assist you with. Always here to help!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! Appreciate it. I'll reach out if I need anything.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Cool! Stay motivated and keep chasing those dreams! Chat soon!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! I'll definitely stay motivated and keep chasing those dreams. You too, keep up the passion. Talk soon!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Hey Tim! Long time no talk - a lot has been going on since then!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Hey John! Long time no see! Can't wait to catch up and hear all about what you've been up to.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Seems like forever since we caught up! I'm now mentoring the younger players on my team. It's super rewarding and I'm loving sharing my skills and knowledge with them. It's also a great way for me to stay involved in the game during the off-season.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow! Mentoring must be so rewarding. You get to show others what you know - that's awesome! Is it difficult? Any hiccups?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: There are challenges, since everyone is so different. But it's been awesome gaining experience and adapting, motivating and encouraging everyone. It's been great to watch each of them develop and reach their goals - such a reward!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow, that's awesome! It must be really rewarding to see them reach their goals. What's it like mentoring them?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Mentoring them has been awesome! Seeing their growth, improvement, and confidence is so fulfilling. I'm glad I could make a positive impact on their lives. Here's a pic of me and some of the younger players at a recent practice. [image: a photography of a basketball player standing in a gym with his hands on his hips]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: You're really doing great with them. Do any of them see you as a mentor?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Some of them do see me as a mentor, which is really rewarding. I try to provide them with advice and support on and off the court. Being a positive role model for them is something I enjoy.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That's incredible! How does it feel to have their trust and admiration? It must be such an honor to be a positive role model for them.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: It feels great to have their trust and admiration. Being a role model for these young athletes is so fulfilling. I'm glad my experiences can help shape their future and inspire them to go after their dreams.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: You're doing a great job with them. Way to go! This is what I've been up to. [image: a photo of a sunset over a mountain range with a few trees]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Wow, stunning! And thanks. Really appreciate it. Means a lot.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: I took this pic last summer. Seeing it was so stunning. Thanks for appreciating it. It means a lot to me. [image: a photo of a sunset over a mountain with a tree]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Where did you capture this? Nature is truly amazing, isn't it?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: I snapped that pic on my trip to the Smoky Mountains last year. It was incredible seeing it in person. Nature's really something else!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yeah, it's amazing how nature's beauty and grandeur can take our breath away. It's so nice to escape the noise of the city and relax in nature. Good for you to get to enjoy that stunning view!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Nature is indeed refreshing. A good break from school.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: How are you doing in shcool?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Doing good! Busy with studies but finding time to relax with books - good balance.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Cool! Finding that balance is key. Are you currently reading any books?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: I'm reading this book and I'm totally hooked! What about you?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: I haven't had much time to read, but after we talked I finally picked up a book and it's been awesome! Talk to you later!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Hey John! Haven't talked to you in a bit but wanted to let you know I read this awesome book about castles in the UK. It was so interesting and blew me away! I dream of visiting them one day.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Hey Tim! Great to hear from you. Learning about different cultures and seeing historical architecture fascinates me. Visiting castles is really on my bucket list. Just look at this one; what a sight! I'm so excited to explore the world and experience these gorgeous places. On that note, how's your fantasy writing going? [image: a photo of a man sitting on a bench overlooking a cliff]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That castle looks amazing! I hope I get to visit it someday. My writing is going well: I'm in the middle of fantasy novel and it's a bit nerve-wracking but so exciting! All my hard work is paying off. Writing brings such joy and it's incredible how it can create a whole new world. Thanks so much for believing in me!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: That's great! I'm glad your writing is going well. It must be exciting to see it all come together. Keep going! Do you have a specific source of inspiration for your stories?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Thanks! Books, movies, and real-life experiences all fire up my creativity. For example, reading about castles in the UK gave me loads of ideas. Plus, certain authors are like goldmines of inspiration for me. Connecting with the things I love makes writing even more fun.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Wow! Sounds like a great mix. Is there a particular author whose work inspires you?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: J.K. Rowling is such an inspiring writer. Her books are so captivating with their detail and creative storytelling. She can definitely transport readers into another world and make them feel so much. I'm always taking notes on her style for my own writing. [image: a photo of a book with a page in it on a table]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Cool! How long have you been reading her works?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: I've been reading her stuff for a long time. Her stories have been with me and still inspire me. There's something special about her writing that really speaks to me.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Wow, some authors really have such an influence on us! They become part of our life and affect our interests. Do you have a favorite J.K. Rowling quote?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Yeah! There's a quote by J.K. Rowling that I really like: "Turn on the light - happiness hides in the darkest of times." That's how I keep hope alive during tough times.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Nice quote! It reminds us to stay positive and find joy even in hard times. It's a guiding light when things get rough. I appreciate you sharing it! [image: a photo of a white board with a drawing of arrows and words]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Nice job, John! What did you write on that whiteboard?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: On that whiteboard, I wrote down some motivational quotes and strategies to help me stay focused and push through tough workouts. It really helps me stay motivated and keep improving.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That's awesome! Visual reminders and strategies can really help in staying motivated. It's cool that you have those quotes to keep you going during tough workouts. [image: a photo of a woman holding a plaque in front of a wall]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: This plaque I keep on my desk is a constant reminder to believe in myself. It helps me trust my abilities and face any obstacles. Having physical reminders like this really helps me stay motivated. [image: a photography of a desk with a laptop and a lightbox that says make it happen]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That's awesome! What keeps you motivated during challenging times?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: My teammates believing in me and my love for improving my skills keep me going, even when things get tough. I don't want to let them down. [image: a photo of a group of women soccer players huddle together]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Nice one! What do you reckon makes them such a good support?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: They always support me, even when I make mistakes. Their encouragement keeps me going.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That's key, having a strong support network can really help with what we're trying to do. Do you have people you can lean on outside of sports? [image: a photo of a group of people hiking through a forest]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yeah, I'm lucky - I have people who are super supportive, always there for me no matter what.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Awesome! Having people who lift us up is essential. I'm grateful I have friends and family who support me - it's huge. [image: a photo of a group of women sitting on the grass eating]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Having loved ones who support us is so important. My family is always there for me. [image: a photo of a group of people standing around a kitchen table]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow, look at this great group! Are these your people?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yeah, definitely! That's my fam hanging out. Being with them brings me so much happiness and helps me remember what's important. My team is like my second family too. [image: a photo of a group of people standing on a basketball court]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That looks fun! What else do you do with them? [image: a photo of a group of kids playing a game of basketball]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: What people usually do when you hang out with friends and family - movies, dinner out. And what are your favorite activities for fun?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: I love going on road trips with friends and family, exploring and hiking or playing board games. And in my free time, I enjoy curling up with a good book, escaping reality and getting lost in different worlds. That's what I'm talking about. [image: a photo of a fire in a fireplace with a dog standing next to it]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yep, I totally get it! Cuddling up with a book is my chill time. And when I'm away from the court, cooking is therapy for me. It's a good way to be creative and experiment with flavors while taking a break. Here's a photo of me cooking a meal. [image: a photo of a slow cooker filled with a mixture of food]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That slow cooker meal looks yum! Cooking is a great way to chill and be creative. Do you have any favorite recipes you can show me?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Definitely! I make this yummy honey garlic chicken with roasted veg a lot. It's one of my favorites. I'm always trying out new recipes, so let me know if you want suggestions! [image: a photo of a pan of chicken and vegetables cooking on a stove]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Mmm, that sounds delicious, John! Can I get the recipe for it?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Sure thing! I can write it down for you and mail it to you.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Can't wait to try it. Thanks for sharing the recipe!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: No worries. Hope you enjoy it! Let me know how it turns out.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Sure thing! Thanks. Great talking to you. Take care!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: It was nice chatting with you. Talk to you later!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Hey John, long time no see! Hope you've been doing well. Since we last chat, some stuff's happened. Last week, I had a huge writing issue - got stuck on a plot twist and couldn't find my way out. It was crazy frustrating, but I kept pushing and eventually got the ideas flowing again.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Hey Tim! Awesome to hear from you. Yeah, I get how that would've been so annoying! But you stuck it out, that's so cool. Same with me on the court. Just gotta find a way to tough it out and keep things flowing. Then when you make it through, it's all the more satisfying, right?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Yeah! It was hard but once it's over, the feeling is amazing. That's what makes it so beautiful, the struggle and then the satisfaction.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yeah! Struggles make it worth it. Like in sports, that's when the win feels great! Challenges force us to develop and become better.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Overcoming challenges builds strength and pushes personal growth. It's about the journey and what we learn, not just winning. This was a great reminder for me. Got any examples from that sport you mentioned?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yeah, last year I had a basketball game where we were trailing big time in the 4th quarter. We had to dig deep and keep on pushing to overturn the deficit and it was amazing when that final buzzer sounded. Unforgettable feeling.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow, that must have been an incredible feeling! You really showed determination and perseverance. Do you have any photos or keepsakes from the game? I'd love to see them! By the way, I have something special too - this is my prized possession, a basketball signed by my favorite player. It serves as a reminder of all the hard work. [image: a photo of a basketball in a case with a signed ball]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Wow! What makes your favorite player so inspiring? Do you have any special stories or moments with them?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: I just love watching LeBron. There was this Finals game a few years back with an epic block that totally changed the game and ended up winning it. Seeing him go for it like that was such an inspiration - never give up, you know?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Remember that epic block in Game 7 of the '16 Finals? He chased down Iguodala and pinned the ball against the backboard. That kind of determination and heart is why I love basketball.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Yeah, that's the one! It was awesome. Moments like that make me love sports and admire the players' determination and heart.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: LeBron's moments of determination and heart are incredible. It's why I enjoy playing and pushing myself. You never know when those special moments might occur, but it's always fun to be part of it.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Those special moments make it all worth it. It's amazing to be part of something bigger and feel the joy and fulfillment. Keep pushing and having those moments on the court!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Speaking of special moments, my wife and I just left for our European vacation! It will be short but sweet. You've been before, any recommendations?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That's great! I hope you two have a great time. I would recommend visiting some castles, they are just so magical!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! We'll have to check some out. Wishing you all the best with everything you're pursuing. Stay safe!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Thanks! You too, buddy. Take it easy and keep going for it. Stay safe and let's stay in touch!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Hey Tim! Great to chat again. So much has happened!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Hey John! Great chatting with you as always. What's been happening lately? I've been reading as usual. [image: a photo of a book with a picture of a storm of swords]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: My wife and I were road tripping out on the European coastline, and it was amazing! The views were spectacular, and we had lots of fun bonding and creating amazing memories. It was such a nice change to my regular life. [image: a photo of a group of people sitting on top of a mountain]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow! Sounds like an incredible road trip. I'm glad you and your wife had such a great time! [image: a photo of a statue of a woman with a blue hat on]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! Yeah, it was awesome. We got to see some epic spots. It's hard to describe how beautiful they were!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Those places must've been amazing! Nature sure has a way of leaving us speechless.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Nature sure is powerful and beautiful! It's really humbling to witness such sights.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Yeah! It always makes us realize how huge the world is and how special it is. These moments really show us the beauty around us. Anyways, have you read or watched anything good recently?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yep, I just finished this amazing fantasy series. It was a wild ride with so many twists. The author is amazing at creating awesome storylines and characters - I love getting lost in those fantasy worlds.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That's amazing! Same here. There's something special about being lost in an awesome fantasy realm and seeing what happens. It's like an escape. "That" is one of my favorite fantasy shows. Have you seen it?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yeah, I saw "That"! It's amazing to see those worlds and characters come alive. It's a great way to escape reality!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Yeah, it's awesome how books and movies can take you away. A great escape, right?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Definitely, it's like a mental break, giving our minds a rest and letting them wander. So refreshing!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: It's like entering another world! We get to take a break from everything and just let our minds wander. It's so nice and refreshing.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: And that's just what we need sometimes.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Taking a break from life can help us recharge and get some peace. Plus, it gives us a chance to reconnect with ourselves and tackle life's challenges with a new outlook.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yeah, taking time for ourselves is crucial. It helps us stay sharp and focused. Plus, it helps us gain new perspectives and tackle challenges with more energy. Finding the right balance is key and I'll keep that in mind as I continue my journey.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Balance is key and it varies. Take care of yourself, both mentally and physically, and you'll rock it. You got this, bud!
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! Your support means a lot. I'll keep pushing forward. Take care, buddy!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Hey John! Hope you're doing good. Guess what? I went to a castle during my trip to the UK last Friday and it was unbelievable! The architecture and the history were amazing! [image: a photo of a castle with a river running through it]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Hey Tim! That's awesome! Yeah, it was really cool. Oh man, it's been a tough week for me with this injury. But I'm staying positive. How about you? How's your week been? [image: a photo of a person with a bandage on their leg]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Ouch, bummer about the injury. Hang tight. This week has been swamped with exams for me but I'm plowing through.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Cheers, Tim. Injury's been rough, but I'm staying positive. How's the exam prep coming? Confident? [image: a photo of a notebook with a bunch of notes on it]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Exams can be challenging, but I'm putting in my best effort. Feeling optimistic and working diligently! How do you stay motivated during difficult study sessions?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: I visualize my goals and success for focus and motivation. It really helps me stay motivated during tough studying. Do you have any study tricks? [image: a photo of a soccer game with a player on the field]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That's cool! I like breaking up my studying into smaller parts. 25 minutes on, then 5 minutes off for something fun. It's less overwhelming and keeps me on track.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Nice work! Breaking it down into smaller parts is definitely a smart move. I wish you all the best on your exams!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Thanks! Appreciate your support. I hope your injury heals soon.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Sure thing, Tim! Got your back. I hope so too. The doctor said it's not too serious.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That's good to hear, I'm glad.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: I hate not being on the court.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: I bet. It's like if I couldn't read due to an injury.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: I'm pushing on though. Talk soon!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow, that's cool! Have you read any of the stories? I'm looking for some travel ideas too.

memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Wow, that sounds awesome! How challenging was the trek through the Himalayas?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: The book mentioned that the trek was tough but worth it, with challenging terrain, altitude sickness, and bad weather. But they made it and saw amazing sights - it really motivated me.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Wow! Sounds like a tough journey.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: It's true. Facing challenges can be tough, but it can make us stronger. I just visited a travel agency to see what the requirements would be for my next dream trip.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: For sure, challenges help us learn and grow. Sounds fun! Keep me updated!

memories.content: Thanks, I will. You have to keep pushing for your goals. [image: a photo of a newspaper article with a picture of a woman]

memories.content: Wow, that's great! It's inspiring to see people who use their platform for important causes and make a difference.

memories.content: Cool! What causes are you working on? Tell me more about them!

memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Cool! What have been some memorable experiences working with them?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Organizing a basketball camp for kids in my hometown last summer was an awesome experience! Seeing their faces light up when they hit the court was priceless. It was a week full of laughs, high-fives, and personal growth for us all. That opportunity to inspire those kids and show them just how much potential they have was truly incredible.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow! Making a difference to those kids was great! Your passion for helping others is awesome. [image: a photo of a basketball with a signed autograph on it]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Thanks! I'm really glad I can make a difference. Have you been doing anything new in your free time?
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: In my downtime, I still love to get lost in good books, and this series is one of my favorites. It's a magical world to escape to. [image: a photo of a collection of harry potter books on a desk]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: That's awesome! Have you seen all the Harry Potter movies? I'm a fan too!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Yeah, I have! Watching them and seeing how they compare to the books is awesome. It's amazing to watch the story come alive. Have you seen all of them?

memories.content: I'm a total movie fan! Seeing it all come alive on the big screen is awesome, and a great way to relax.

memories.content: Yeah, watching movies is a fun way to relax. We love having movie marathons with our friends. [image: a photography of three guys sitting on a couch watching a movie]

memories.content: What's it called? I'm always down for something new.

memories.content: I'm really excited to watch this new show that's coming out called "The Wheel of Time". It's based on a book series that I love.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: That sounds exciting!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Yeah, can't wait to check out the series. It's always fun seeing the books come to life on screen! Talk to you later!

memories.content: Hey Tim! Cool to hear about your globetrotting group! Must be great connecting with other traveling buffs. By the way, have you been to Italy? I had a blast there last month.

memories.content: It's been awesome chatting with fellow travel enthusiasts. Italy is definitely on my list of places to visit. How was your trip there last month? [image: a photo of a book with a tag on it]

memories.content: Italy was awesome! Everything from the food to the history and architecture was amazing. I even got this awesome book while I was there and it's been giving me some cooking inspiration.

memories.content: Wow, traveling is amazing, isn't it? I'm learning German now - tough but fun. Do you know any other languages?

memories.content: Learning German has been tough but worth it. I like the structure of the language, it's much easier when I took French in high school. What made you decide to learn Spanish? [image: a photo of a book sitting on a table next to a wall]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: I've always wanted to learn Spanish. I just stared with it. It's such a useful language with many personal and professional opportunities!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Yeah, knowing another language opens up a lot of opportunities. Have you come across any good resources for learning Spanish? I've been using this app. [image: a photo of a cell phone sitting on a notebook with a smiley face app]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yeah! I've been using that app on my phone to practice too! It's helped a lot.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: That app is great. Learning another language is tough, but the rewards are totally worth it.
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: It takes dedication and practice, but it's so rewarding to communicate with different cultures. Keep it up with German! [image: a photo of a basketball ball on the ground with a basketball hoop in the background]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Thanks! I appreciate your encouragement. I'm definitely going to keep up with my German lessons. Do you still play basketball often?

memories.content: Wow! Love the way you go for it. Don't ever quit on what you love. I will always love reading, personally. [image: a photo of a collection of harry potter books on a desk]

memories.content: Thanks! I won't give up on it. What got you into books?

memories.content: Harry Potter is my favorite book. It's so immersive! [image: a photo of a collection of movies and dvds on a carpet]

memories.content: Cool! Glad you're enjoying that book! Do you have any favorite fantasy movies as well? These are mine. [image: a photo of a collection of star wars movies on a table]

memories.content: Definitely Star Wars! It's my favorite and never gets old. What about you, do you have any favorite fantasy films?

memories.content: I'm a huge fan of Lord of the Rings! The adventure, the world, and the characters are awesome. [image: a photo of a shelf with a lot of books on it]

memories.content: Wow, me too! That's an awesome collection! Have you watched them heaps? Got any favorite characters from those movies? [image: a photo of a bookcase filled with dvds and games]

memories.content: Thanks! I've watched a bunch of them and they're inspiring. My favorite character is Aragorn, he grows so much throughout the story. [image: a photo of a bookmark with a picture of a woman kissing a man]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Nice one! Why is he your favorite?
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: He's a great leader and puts others first - that's why he eventually becomes king.
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow, Aragorn's story is so inspiring - from a ranger to king of Gondor. It's amazing how he grows and achieves redemption throughout his journey. [image: a photo of a painting of a man with long hair]
memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Yeah. His journey is really inspiring. I have a painting in my room to remind me to stay true and be a leader in everything I do. [image: a photo of a painting of a man smoking a cigarette]
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Wow, that's awesome! What is it about him that makes him so inspiring for you?

memories.content: Aragorn's brave, selfless, down-to-earth attitude is what inspired me. He never gives up and always stands up for justice.

memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Wow, that looks awesome! Exploring different lands and regions in fantasy stories is always fun!
memories.speaker: John

memories.content: Yeah, it really is. It helps you see new things and get a different view of everything. It's so cool and educational! Talk to you later!

memories.content: Great job organizing the event. That's really making a difference!

memories.speaker: Tim

memories.content: Hey Andrew! Good to see ya! What's been up since we last talked?
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Hey Audrey! So, I started a new job as a Financial Analyst last week - it's been quite a change from my previous job. How about you? Anything interesting happening?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Congrats on the new job! So I got these new collars and tags for my dogs - so cute!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Thanks! That sounds cute. Can I see a picture?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Sure! See them with their new collars, cute right? [image: a photography of two dogs are standing in the grass with their mouths open]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Cute little guys! What are their names and how long have you had them?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: I've had them for 3 years! Their names are Pepper, Precious and Panda. I can't live without my little ones!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: That's awesome! Have you always wanted a dog, even with living in the city? Can they still go on adventures?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Absolutely! They're city dogs and we explore all the time. They love trying out new parks and trails. We go on adventures together very often.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Wow, sounds like they make life so awesome! Kinda jealous of all those fun outings with them.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: They really do! It's great how much happiness they bring. Do you have any pets?
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: No, no pets right now. But I do love animals.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: That's great to hear! Animals are truly amazing. Do you have a favorite animal?
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: I've always been awed by birds. Their power to soar and explore new spots is amazing.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Yeah, birds are amazing! I can imagine it feels incredible to soar and see the world from up high. Do you have a favorite type of bird?
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Eagles have always mesmerized me; they're so strong and graceful! [image: a photo of two birds flying in the sky with a sun shining behind them]
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Yeah they're beautiful. Do you go bird-watching? It must be awesome to see them up close.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Haven't specifically gone out for bird-watching, but I do spot them when I hike.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Nice, spotting pretty birds while hiking must be great. Do you have any favorite hiking spots?
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Fox Hollow is a great trail to hike on weekends; the views are awesome!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Cool, gonna give it a try. Thanks for the suggestion!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: No problem! Let me know how you like it. Have fun hiking!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Thanks! I'll let you know. Have a good one!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Take care and have a good one! See ya!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Hey Andrew, I got a surprise for you! We adopted another puppy called Pixie. She's SO cute! Isn't she just the cutest? [image: a photo of a small white dog sitting on a carpet]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: That's awesome! Pixie is so cute! Did you ever check out that hiking spot we talked about last time?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Thanks! I know right? She's so cute! Pixie's been keeping us busy, so I haven't had a chance to check out that hiking spot yet.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Yeah, I get it. A puppy really takes some work. Has she settled in okay? Is she getting along with the other pups?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Pixie's fitting in great! It took her a few days to get used to the other dogs, but now they're awesome friends. They love playing and exploring the house - so cute! [image: a photography of a dog playing with a group of other dogs]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: That's awesome! Is Pepper adjusting well to her?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Pepper took a bit to get used to her, but now they're always together! [image: a photography of two dogs standing in the grass near a fence]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: That's great to hear! I'm considering getting a dog too, but it can be challenging finding a dog-friendly place in the city. Do you have any tips on finding such a place?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: We used websites that helped us find a place that allowed dogs. They had filters that made it super easy. Found a perfect spot thanks to them! [image: a photography of a dog sitting in a field of flowers]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Wow, that's so cool! I'll give those websites a try, thanks for the info!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: You got it! I hope you find a great spot soon!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Thanks! Fingers crossed for the apartment and that furry friend.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: I'm keeping my fingers crossed for you to find a great furry friend and an apartment.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Hope I find one soon. Can't wait!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: You'll love them! They're great for cuddles and companionship.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: It'd be so great to have a furry buddy to cuddle and hang with. Here's a photo of my family's dog on a couch. [image: a photo of a dog sitting on a couch in a living room]
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Our furry friends make great cuddle buddies. Here's one of them enjoying some lazy couch time! [image: a photography of a dog laying on a couch with a pillow]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: That pic is so cute! It would be fun to hang out with a dog, cuddling away. Got me thinking of my old hiking pics and how much I miss exploring nature trails with my family's dog. Ah, the peaceful moments out in nature! [image: a photo of a man walking a dog on a trail]
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Taking them on hikes must be awesome! That makes me want to hike with my dogs.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Hiking with a dog is way fun, it's a great way to bond and create memories together. [image: a photography of a man sitting on a rock with a dog]
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Yeah! Exploring nature with them and making memories is awesome!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Definitely! I miss those moments. I need to find a dog-friendly spot soon so I can get exploring again!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Yep! I hope you find the perfect dog-friendly spot soon so you can make new memories with them.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Thanks! I'll keep looking until I find it. Super excited for what's next!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: So excited for you! I can't wait to see where you and your furry friend decide to hang out. All the best!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: I'll keep you posted. Ttyl, Bye!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Hey Audrey! What's up? Missed chatting with ya! Check it out, my girl & I tried out that new cafe scene in the city last weekend! Super fun but kinda sad not being out in nature - that's when I feel like I'm really thriving. Oh man, I miss the peacefulness of being out on a hike.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Hey Andrew! That cafe sounds pretty awesome, glad you enjoyed it. Yeah, I know what you mean. That feeling of being out in nature, surrounded by beauty and peace, is unbeatable, compared to being surrounded by concrete jungles.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Yeah, being out in the nature really has a way of taking my breath away. It's like a home for my soul! I feel connected when I'm there.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: I totally get it. Nature has a way of bringing us back down to earth and reminding us that we're part of something bigger. It's amazing.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Yeah, it's like hitting the reset button when life gets too chaotic. Nature has a way of being really soothing.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Definitely! For me, taking my dogs for a walk in the park helps me find my center and recharges me.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: I hear ya. Can’t do that here unfortunately, city living makes it hard. Really miss that connection and companionship.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Must be tough living in the city without the opportunity to go outside. Sure is a different experience.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Yeah, it really does. Sometimes it feels like I'm missing out.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: It must be tough. City life can get overwhelming, so it's great to find ways to connect to nature. What kind of things do you like to do in the city?
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: My girlfriend and I love to discover new places to eat around town. It's a great way to try something new and wind down after a long week.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Wow, that sounds like a great way to explore the city! Trying new places and food is always fun. Have you discovered any new favorite spots recently?
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: We found an awesome cafe with amazing pastries - the smell was just irresistible!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Sounds amazing! Did you take a photo? I'd love to see!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Yep, I got them! Check out this photo of the delicious pastries we had at the cafe. [image: a photo of a bakery display with pastries and coffee]
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Wow, they look great! What did you get? Now I'm craving pastries!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: They taste great too! We had some delicious croissants, muffins, and tarts! It was amazing!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Wow, sounds amazing! Glad you got to enjoy them. Since you metioned pastries, I made some of my favorite treats last week. Let's have a pastry party sometime! [image: a photo of a muffin pan filled with blueberries and muffins]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: That looks delicious! A pastry party sounds awesome, count me in!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Awesome! My dogs will tag along. My furry friends would love it!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Definitely! They'll have a great time at the party! Can't wait for the party!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Same! Looking forward to it. This would be a good chance for you to hang out with them.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Yeah! It's gonna be awesome to see all of them together and chowing down. Super excited!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Yay! This'll be awesome! Seeing them all together, having fun and enjoying treats is the best. I can't imagine life without them, they bring so much joy. [image: a photography of a dog running with three other dogs in the background]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Aww, so cute! I bet their happy faces means a lot to you.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: I know right? They mean the world to me. So much that I got tattoos of them on my arm. [image: a photo of a woman with a tattoo of a dog and sunflowers]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Wow, that tattoo looks great!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Thanks! I got it a while ago. It represents my love for my pups and nature's beauty. [image: a photography of a woman walking with her dogs in the woods]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Aww, that's cute! What made you getting the tattoo?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: I've always had a strong bond with them – they make me so happy, and I just want to see their happy faceseven when thry're not with me.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: That's awesome, I'm glad they bring so much joy into your life.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Hey Andrew! Long time no talk! Last week I finally went on a hike and had this amazing experience with a hummingbird. It was so cool watching it dart around with its wings! Nature is so beautiful. [image: a photography of a hummingbird sitting on a branch with its wings spread]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Hey Audrey! Glad to hear from you. That hummingbird was awesome! Nature's the best. Remember I was feeling down because I couldn't get out more? Well, good news - I found a new open space to hike nearby - feels so refreshing! [image: a photo of a view of a lake and mountains at sunset]
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: That looks great! How often are you able to go hiking now?
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: So I usually try to escape the city at least once a weekend - it's my much-needed break!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Nice! I Bet it's great to get away like that.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Yep! Nature is so therapeutic for me. It's hard to put into words how great it feels to be surrounded by greenery or standing on top of a mountain breathing in the fresh air. So peaceful and invigorating. [image: a photo of a mountain range with a sunset in the background]
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Wow, that view looks great! It really captures that calming and peaceful feeling. It must be really satisfying to capture that tranquility.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Yeah! I try to capture those special moments and share that feeling with others.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: That's really cool! Spreading that peaceful feeling to others is such a great way to bring happiness and motivation.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: I agree! It brings me joy to spread that feeling and motivate people to find their own peace - it's like a ripple effect, spreading positivity.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Absolutely. Not only the receiving end feels great, the person spreading it will feel great as well!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Yeah, it's crazy how that can bring such great joy and calm to people.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Yeah, by sharing something can make a big difference to others.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Yup! We don't realize it, but even the littlest gestures can have a big effect. Spreading good vibes and joy, that's the goal right? So what's up? Anything new or fun going on?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Not much has changed since we last talked. I'm busy taking care of my pets and spending time with them. It's really fulfilling. [image: a photography of a group of dogs sitting on top of a lush green field]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: I bet it's awesome hanging out with them - do your dogs enjoy going on hikes?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: My dogs go nuts when we go on hikes! They love exploring new scents and being in nature - it's their happy place. I can tell by their wagging tails and expressions how much they love it. It's so great to see them having so much fun! [image: a photo of a dog running in a field with other dogs]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Wow, that's great! I was wondering if you have any tips or tricks for keeping dogs safe when they're out and about?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Definitely! Safety is super important for me. I even got them something special. They sure look funny, but it works! [image: a photo of a dog with a leash and shoes on]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Awesome to see that you take such good care of your dogs! What else do you do when you walk them?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: When I take them out, we usually play fetch with a ball or frisbee. They love chasing it! We also meet other dog owners in the park and have a doggie playdate. It's a great way for me to chat with people and for them to make new friends. [image: a photography of a dog catching a frisbee in a field]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Wow, looks like fun! They sure look excited about playing fetch!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: They absolutely adore it! They have tons of energy and love meeting new pals at playdates. Plus, they always get excited when I bring those out. [image: a photo of a dog wearing a party hat sitting on a couch]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Aww, that's so cute! Do they enjoy wearing the party hats? And where did you find their playdates?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: The hats don't bother them, they just put them on for fun and treats. And the dog park is great place to start! They can run and mingle with other pooches. It's such a fun spot for playdates! [image: a photography of a dog jumping through a ring in a park]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: That sounds great! Where is it located?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: It's right by the park we usually walk. It's a great spot with lots of trees and benches for us to watch the dogs play.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: That's awesome, not too far away then! I'll have to check it out. Thanks for the suggestion!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Yup! Not at all! Let me know how it goes.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Sure, I'll let you know. Always great chatting with you! Ttyl.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Hey! Since we last spoke, I've been looking for a doggo to adopt - browsing websites, visiting shelters and asking friends of theirs. It's been both fun and annoying! [image: a photography of a dog looking through a cage at the camera]
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Sounds like a fun and demanding task! Getting to meet new pups must bring so much happiness. What  do you think you can do to make the process smoother? [image: a photo of two dogs running in a field with a ball in their mouth]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Meeting all these adorable pups has been awesome! For those considering getting a pup, the size of living space and the exercise needs of the breed are important. For me, a person living in an apartment, a smaller dog would be best, but if one is active, consider getting one that loves to play and run.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: That's some good advice! It's important to consider the space and energy needs of a dog.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Yeah! Finding a pet-friendly place to live has been tough too. I'm contacting landlords and checking out neighborhoods to find the perfect spot.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Guessing it's tough to find housing. Any particular part of town you want to live in?
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: I'm looking for a place near a park or woods, so I can stay close to nature and give the dog a large open space to run around
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: That's a good plan! I'm lucky to have a park near me - it's great for my pup's walks. Last Friday we took a road trip - we went to a beautiful national park and my dogs had a blast! It was an awesome trip! [image: a photography of three dogs running through a field of grass]
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Nice! Glad the pups had a great road trip. Do you take them on road trips often?
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: I take them on road trips once every couple of months. It's a great way for them to explore and stay active.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Wow, that's awesome! I really wish I could go on a road trip with a furry companion.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: It's a cool experience. Having your furry friends on a road trip is an amazing experience. They make it really fun and exciting. It's definitely something to look forward to!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Adding that to my bucket list! Can't wait for the day I actually go on a trip with my dog!
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Good luck with your search! Fingers crossed you find the perfect one.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Thanks! Your help is much appreciated. I'm still on the lookout for the perfect furry friend.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Not a problem, I'm glad to help! Good luck with your search!
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Thanks! I'll let you know how it goes.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Definitely, keep me posted and let me know if you need any suggestions or help.
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Will do! Really apprecieate it.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Yup! You got it, I'll be expecting a pic of your dog soon! :)
memories.speaker: Audrey

memories.content: Haha I can't wait. I'll ttyl, gotta check out another shelter soon.
memories.speaker: Andrew

memories.content: Have fun! Ttyl!
