memories.content: I'll keep you posted! Appreciate the support! Here are my sketches in the planner. [image: a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notebook with a page of notes]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Sounds like you're doing great. Let me know if you need more tips or information.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deb! If I need anything else, I'll let you know. You're awesome!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: You're awesome too! Take care!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Stay safe!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Hey Deborah, totally buzzing! Had a great night out last night - dinner, and drinks with my friends. So glad I got to let my hair down. You? [image: a photo of a plate of food and a glass of wine]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Sounds great, Jolene! I just visited this place and it was so calming. Nostalgic too. [image: a photo of a garden with a bunch of flowers in buckets]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow, those flowers are beautiful! What type are they? It looks so peaceful there.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: The roses and dahlias bring me peace. I lost a friend last week, so I've been spending time in the garden to find some comfort.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Sorry to hear about your friend, Deb. Losing someone can be really tough. How are you holding up?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Thanks for the kind words. It's been tough, but I'm comforted by remembering our time together. It reminds me of how special life is.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Memories can give us so much comfort and joy.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Memories keep our loved ones close. This is the last photo with Karlie which was taken last summer when we hiked. It was our last one. We had such a great time! Every time I see it, I can't help but smile. [image: a photo of two women are riding on a motorcycle on a dirt road]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow, looks like a great trip! Where else have you traveled?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I've been blessed to travel to a few places and Bali last year was one of my favs. It was a gorgeous island that gave me peace, great for yoga. [image: a photo of a swing on a beach with a blue sky]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow, that's great! Is yoga on the beach a thing? I've been wanting to try it.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: The sound of the waves and the fresh air is wonderful!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'll definitely give it a go! It sounds peaceful. Thanks!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Let me know how it goes. Enjoy it!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'll keep you posted if I decide to go there.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Take care!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hi Deborah, it's been a while! Since we last talked, so much has happened. Balancing engineering school with my partner's video games is quite a feat. But I'm also setting aside time for myself, doing yoga and meditation. It helps give me calm amidst the craziness.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Hey Jolene! Great to hear from you. Taking a break is key. How have those practices been helping with everything?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: They seriously saved me. I chill out and gain perspective when I do yoga. Afterward, I'm more alert and motivated. Here is my last photo. [image: a photo of a woman sitting on a yoga mat doing a yoga pose]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Wow, cool that yoga has been helping you out! Do they also do yoga with you? Does your partner do yoga with you?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: He started joining me sometimes, which is nice for bonding and relaxing. It's brought us closer. This is just our random photo. [image: a photo of a man and a woman holding hands with rings on them]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Aw, that's wonderful! How long have you been married?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: We're not married yet but we've been together for three years. We're taking it slow and loving the ride. This ring on his hand is just a decoration, not a wedding ring.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Sounds nice, Jolene. Enjoying the journey is the main thing. So, how did you two meet?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: We actually met in an engineering class in college and quickly became friends. It eventually blossomed into something more and it's been great! [image: a photo of a book and a calculator on a table]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Wow, your relationship started from a strong friendship. Do you still enjoy working on engineering projects together?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yep, teaming up for these projects feels great! We get each other's struggles and both love it. [image: a photo of a group of men standing in front of a building]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Have yoga or meditation helped with any stress?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Whenever I'm overwhelmed, I just take a break and do some breathing or meditate. It really helps me feel calmer and clearer, so I'm able to handle challenges more easily.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's been great to see your progress since we last chatted - keep it up!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deb! Your support really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and continue taking time for myself.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Always rooting for you. Remember to listen to your heart and take good care. Here's a photo I took while reflecting outdoors. It's a reminder to find peace even in chaos. [image: a photo of a person sitting on a bench looking at the sunset]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm curious, what does your daily routine look like?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: In the morning, I meditate, do yoga, and teach classes. And yesterday I went for a morning jog for the first time in a nearby park. I will now incorporate this into my daily routine. And in the evenings, I spend time with loved ones.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Why did you decide that?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Exercise is key for me - it makes me feel connected to my body.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: This is a great healthy habit!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's like they say - "Can't pour from an empty cup." Looking out for ourselves gives us the energy to help others. And don't forget, you're worth it too!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deb. Your words really mean something to me. I'll keep remembering to prioritize self-care.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Hey Jolene, Anna got me a vegan stir-fry the other day - tofu and veg with ginger and soy sauce. It was really tasty! Food is such a wonderful source of pleasure and nourishment. What dishes are comforting to you?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: One of my favorite dishes is lasagna! Comfort food can be a great pick-me-up. I've got a lot going on with my studies and exams.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Have you been able to find time for yourself lately?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I've been trying to squeeze in some me-time. Last Friday, I did yoga and meditation to relax. Did you find time for yourself too? [image: a photo of a room with a wooden floor and a window]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I also did the same, it helped me reset my mind. How does it make you feel?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It's amazing how a few quiet moments can work wonders for the soul. [image: a photo of a purse with a plant on a table]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Have you been able to get outside lately?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I did take Seraphim to the park last Sunday. She loved it and here's a pic. [image: a photo of a lizard laying on the ground surrounded by leaves]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Looks like you guys had fun!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: We explored new places. People are surprised when they see a tamed snake. What do you like about being outdoors?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Hmm... The birds chirping and the breeze gently blowing! It reminds me of what really matters.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yep, it's like a reminder to slow down and appreciate the little things.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Is there anything you want to be more mindful of right now?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I need to be more mindful of my stress levels and take care of my mental health. Sometimes I get too caught up in my studies and forget to prioritize self-care.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Life can get hectic and it's easy to forget about ourselves.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Exams and deadlines got me feeling overwhelmed. Just look at my to-do list! It seems never-ending... Trying my best but it's been challenging. [image: a photo of a desk with a notebook and a computer monitor]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Your efforts will bear fruit, don't give up!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deb. Any tips on studying or time management?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: My tip is to break it into smaller pieces and set goals for yourself. For time management, planners or schedulers help you stay organized and give you time for yourself. Let me know if you need help with a study plan!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I appreciate your help with that.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Take care and good luck with your exams. I'll give you a mug just like this one! It encourages. [image: a photo of a yellow coffee cup with a handwritten message]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deb! This really cheered me up. All the best with your classes. Bye!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Thanks, Jolene! Glad I could bring a smile to your face. Take care and make sure to give yourself some time to relax. Bye!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hi Jolene! We haven't corresponded for a long time!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hey Deb, yeah life can get chaotic. How's it been going lately?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: So much has been going on lately. I started this yoga class in the neighborhood - it's such a good feeling! Now I get to share the exercise with my neighbors and watch it really transform them.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Congrats. How did you do this?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Thanks! My neighbors were interested in trying yoga, so I hosted a class for them on Friday. It was great to see everyone embrace and enjoy it. Here is our photo together. [image: a photo of a group of women posing for a picture]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: That's cool! What made you want to start teaching it?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I find it calming and wanted to share that with others. Giving people peace and awareness brings me so much happiness.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow, Deb! It's awesome when we can share something we love and make things better for others.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Teaching it is awesome because it can help others and I've made such great friends through it. It's really nice for building community connections.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: That's really motivating. It's great to have support in tough times.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's one of life's best parts, right?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yeah, having someone to rely on is key in tough times. It really makes a difference in how we handle life. Plus, there's something I wanted to tell you.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: What's up? I'm listening. We'll figure it out.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm having a hard time dealing with my Engineering assignments. It's a lot to manage and I'm struggling to keep up. Can we still talk about time management?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Sure, Jolene. Let's find a time that works for both of us.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Let's find a time to chat - I'll check my schedule and get back to you.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Take your time, Jolene. We'll work it out. Take care of yourself, OK?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'll make sure to take it. See you soon!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I'm here for you if you need me. Let's catch up soon.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Have a great day!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Hey Jolene, it's been a while. Hope you're doing okay with all your exams and deadlines. I know it's difficult for you right now.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hey Deb! Yeah, it can be tough. Trying to find time for everything is like playing catch-up - really stressful!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: How do you manage your time and stay organized with all the projects and deadlines?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm using the Pomodoro Technique - 25 minutes work, 5-minute break - to avoid burnout but I'm still struggling to prioritize. Do you have any other tips on time management?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I create a daily schedule or to-do list. Here's my example for today. [image: a photo of a notepad with a list of things to do]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I tried making one but it's kinda overwhelming when it's a big stack of tasks. Here's an example from last Friday. [image: a photo of a notepad with notes on it on a counter]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Have you tried breaking it down or prioritizing the tasks?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It can often feel overwhelming and difficult to figure out where to start.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I get it, Jolene. When I'm overloaded, I use a certain method. It helps me figure out what's important and urgent so I'm more organized. Do you know about it?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Nah, I'm not familiar with that one. What's it about?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Want me to tell you about it? It helps you organize things based on how important and urgent they are.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Sure, tell me more about it! It sounds useful.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: The Eisenhower Matrix sorts tasks into four boxes, categorizing them based on their urgency and importance. It can be really useful for organizing and prioritizing. Here's a breakdown. [image: a photo of a pair of scissors sitting on top of a piece of paper]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: The visualization is helpful too. Thanks for sharing!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I am glad, it was helpful. Let's give it a try and see if it helps you stay focused and less stressed.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yeah, I'll give it a go. Fingers crossed it'll help me. Thanks for the help!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Don't forget to take it easy and look after yourself. Wishing you all the best! Recently, Anna and I were sitting by the sea, watching the sunset and talking about each other. And we realized that we inspire each other. What thoughts does the sea in this photo make you think of? [image: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: This gets me thinking of when I'll learn to surf. Gotta find that spare time!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Surfing, huh Jolene? Chase your dreams, don't be daunted. Have you thought about the steps you can take?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Definitely! I've been gathering information, watching videos, and I even got a beginners' guide to surfing. Just need to find the right time and place to get a lesson.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Way to go! Taking those first steps is key. Believe in yourself and keep going! [image: a photo of a row of surfboards leaning against a palm tree]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks for the support! Those got me pumped to try surfing. Gonna keep pushing myself to make it happen.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Keep it up, Jolene! Remember, the experience matters just as much as the end result. Step by step and have fun along the way. You can do it!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks for the boost!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Hey Deb, long time no talk. A lot's happened! On Friday I had a breakthrough with my engineering project. Finally found a solution to a prob that's been bugging me. Feels great to see my hard work paying off. [image: a photo of a person's hand holding a pair of scissors]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: You've really proven your skills. Feels great, right? Keep it up! And I bought new props for the yoga class! Here it is in action. [image: a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a room]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Oh, I also have new details for this case! Rate it! [image: a photo of a cardboard mat with a cup of coffee on it]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: That`s cool! I also bought this candle for the atmosphere and to improve my yoga practice. How about you? When you do it, what feelings do you get? [image: a photo of a candle with a sprig of rosemary on a table]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I feel relaxed during this activity. I love creating a serene space with soothing scents like lavender and rosemary. Do you have any favorite scents or rituals for when you do it?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I'm also a big fan of scents like this! Candles and essential oils add warmth and calm to my yoga session. It's amazing how certain smells can transport you to a place of peace.  Do you have any other ways to enhance your yoga practice?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I find music helps me. Any favorite tracks?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I find instrumental tracks with mellow melodies and rhythms help create a peaceful vibe. One of my favorites is a track called "Savana." What songs/artists do you like listening to during your practice?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I love listening to Nils Frahm and Olafur Arnalds during my practice. Their music is so calming and puts me in a different headspace. Do you have any recommendations for other similar artists or tracks I should check out?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Also, I'm listening to an album called 'Sleep,' which is great for meditation and deep relaxation. Hope you find it as calming as I do!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks for the tips, Deborah! I'm gonna check them out. It's always good to have some new tunes for yoga!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Let me know your thoughts on the albums!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: See you!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Take care and keep up the good work!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hey Jolene! Great to see you! Had a blast biking nearby with my neighbor last week - was so freeing and beautiful. Checked out an art show with a friend today - really cool and inspiring stuff. Reminded me of my mom. [image: a photo of a large brown and white photo of a person]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hey Deborah! Sounds like you had a blast biking and at the art show. Your photo looks like you were really into it! Did it make you think profound thoughts?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: My mom was interested in art. She believed art could give out strong emotions and uniquely connect us. When I go to an art show, it's like we're still experiencing it together even though she's gone. It's hard but comforting.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Losing someone is hard, but finding something that helps you cope is great.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Finding ways to keep her memory alive gives me peace. It's amazing how something simple like artwork can bring back powerful emotions and remind us of those we've lost. It's about finding solace in the things we love, and art has done that for me.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Even though my snakes can't chat or understand what I'm going through, our time together is valuable and teaches me to take time and be in tune with myself. Similarly, playing video games with my partner after a long day is a great way for me to relax.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Simple things can indeed bring us the most happiness. How have these activities helped you during tough times?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It brings us closer together!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: This kind of comfort can be really helpful when times get tough.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Just so you know, I've been working on a big project lately - it's been tough but also really cool to watch it take shape. Can't wait to see the final result!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I am waiting to hear how everything turns out. Keep up the good work!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks Deb! Your support means a lot. I'll keep you updated on the progress of the project.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Glad my support means a lot to you! I'll always be here for you.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Take care!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Enjoy your day and make time for the things that bring you joy. See ya!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'll make sure to find time for that. Have a good one!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Hey Deborah! Long time no talk - I had lots of stuff going on. Remember the tough engineering project? I finally wrapped that up last month. Look at the result! [image: a photo of a solar powered vehicle with a solar panel on the back]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Jolene! Congrats on wrapping up your with it! You really put in the work and it paid off.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm really proud of myself for sticking it out despite the problems and finishing it. It's definitely a big milestone.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Now that you've reached this big milestone, what do you have planned next?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm interning at a well-known engineering firm. It's been a great opportunity to test my skills and gain real-world experience. These are my new colleagues! [image: a photo of a group of construction workers posing for a picture]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: What's been the best part of it so far?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: The best part so far has been being able to apply what I learned in school to real projects. It's so fulfilling to see my ideas come to life.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Mind if I ask how the internship has impacted you?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It has had a positive impact on my life. It has stoked my love of engineering and has encouraged me to keep striving for my dreams.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: How has it inspired you to keep striving for your dreams?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hanging out with people who love what they do has really inspired me to stay focused and keep working towards my goals. It's shown me that with dedication and effort, anything is possible.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Have you been able to find a good work-life balance during your internship?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Honestly, finding that balance has been tough. I've been slogging away and it's been hard to make time for my hobbies and chilling out.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Have you considered taking some breaks and finding activities like yoga to help you relax and unwind? That might make a difference.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yeah, I`m trying to do it. Here's an example of how I spent yesterday morning, yoga on top of mount Talkeetna. [image: a photo of a man standing on a rock with his arms outstretched]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Nice job, Jolene! How long have you been doing yoga and meditation? It looks like it's really helping you regroup and recharge.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I've been doing them sporadically for about 3 years now and they've had a real positive effect on me.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Has it benefited you in any way? Have you found it helpful in difficult moments?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It has helped me with stress and kept me centered.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Glad they've been helpful for you!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: No idea how I would've survived without them!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: This is my favorite studio and it's always so calming. [image: a photo of a room with a bench and a window]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I was wondering if you have any advice on calming the mind and breathing during yoga?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I'd recommend practicing mindful breathing for yoga. Set aside a few minutes each day to sit with your eyes closed, take deep breaths, and focus on how the air feels entering and leaving your body.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deborah! I'll definitely give it a try. Appreciate the advice!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: If you need more tips or help, just let me know. Take care!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: See you!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Hey Jolene! How's it going? We haven't talked in a while. I've been busy getting ready for a yoga retreat with some buddies. A chance to hang out with people who think like me and find peace and understanding. Sounds awesome! [image: a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a park]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hey Deb! Been super hectic with internship and stuff. That retreat sounds awesome, I could definitely use a break!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: By the way, I tried a new pose - Dancer Pose (Natarajasana). Rate, did I succeed? [image: a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: You are amazing as always! Here are new photos of Seraphim in the new aquarium that I bought the day before yesterday. [image: a photo of a snake curled up in a plant filled area]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Where'd you get it? I'm always drawn to animals, they bring so much joy. What's its story?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I got her last year, she's a great pet. She always cheers me up and brings a sense of peace. Spending time with her is so comforting.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Pets really do make life more enjoyable and bright. [image: a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a field]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm so thankful it's here. Plus, it's nice to have a calm creature around.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: How have things been besides that?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Things have been intense lately. I'm really pushing myself to succeed, and sometimes it feels overwhelming. But I'm determined to overcome any obstacles and achieve my goals.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Keep up the hard work and remember to relax too.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deborah! I had a big breakthrough with this project - so exciting and rewarding! [image: a photo of a drawing of a house with a ruler and a ruler]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Awesome, Jolene! I'm really glad your project worked out.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Stop talking about me, tell me more about your retreat.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I'd rather show you a photo. This is also a new yoga pose that we tried. It is a tree pose. [image: a photo of three people standing in front of a large statue]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: What's that statue in the picture?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's a symbol of peace and enlightenment.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow, it looks gorgeous! I'd love to visit a retreat like that. It seems like the ideal spot to find peace and refreshment.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's perfect for reflecting and getting centered.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I could really use some chill time like that. Sounds so peaceful.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Yeah, we all need some peaceful time to relax.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Gotta run, have a nice day!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: See you! [image: a photo of a sunset reflecting in a lake with a boat]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hey Jolene! I started a running group with Anna - it's awesome connecting with people who care about fitness! [image: a photo of three men standing next to each other on a road]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Cool, Deb! Glad you found some people to get fit with. I'm trying to add workouts into my studying schedule, which has been tough but fun. How about you? Any challenges with the running group?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Oh, I'm having a blast with it! We help and push each other during our runs, which makes it so much easier to stay motivated.  I have a lot of my photos from this activity. [image: a photo of a woman standing on a sidewalk with a skateboard]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Deborah, that's awesome! Being part of a supportive group must be super motivating. Finding a team that's passionate about something makes a huge difference. Just thinking about my own journey too.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Having people who can cheer you on and give you advice really makes a difference. What has it been like for you finding supportive folks?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Gaming's been tough lately, but I'm grateful I have someone who's also into it. My partner helps me stay focused on our goals. We have a lot of cute photos, I want to share with you. [image: a photo of a man and a woman sitting in a chair in front of a computer]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: What do you like best about gaming together?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: We get to tackle challenges and have a shared experience. It's always a blast when we're into the same game and achieve something tough. Plus, it's a great way to bond and get closer.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Woah, that's cool! Gaming is so good for strengthening relationships. Do you two have a favorite game to play together?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yeah, we love playing "It takes two" together! It's a fun team-strategy game and it's competitive. Plus, it's a great way for us to bond. Do you have any activities you like doing with people?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Yep, I do running and yoga/meditation with others. Connecting with people and creating a community is great. Plus, I love organizing workshops and events to practice mindfulness and self-care. It's an awesome way to have fun, build relationships, and support each other's growth. [image: a photo of a group of people doing yoga in a park]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Sounds like a great way to relax. What do your workshops and events involve?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It involves various activities such as yoga, meditation, and self-reflection. They aim to cultivate self-awareness, promote mental and emotional well-being, and help individuals find inner peace. It's a space where people can connect, explore, and grow.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Your events are awesome for helping people connect and learn, it is so important. How has everything been going for you?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Thanks, Jolene! It's been great seeing everyone come together and support each other. It's amazing to witness the growth and transformation that happens through these workshops. I'm honored to be a part of it. [image: a photo of a game board with a bunch of cards on it]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow, Deb! I can imagine how rewarding it must be to create a space for growth and change. It's great to hear that everything's going well. You can always count on me for support! I just want to share a photo with you. [image: a photo of a snake on a branch with a book]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Thanks, Jolene! Your support means a lot to me. I'm here for you too. By the way, I noticed your pet in the picture. What made you decide to get a snake?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I was fascinated by reptiles, and it felt like the perfect pet for me. Taking care of it has been really calming, and it's a great way to connect with nature.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Glad you found something that gives you peace and calm. Do you have a favorite memory with "it" to share?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I have lots of great memories, like our little 'snake adventure'. She got out and I spent hours searching, so relieved when I finally found her snuggling under the bed. It really showed how much I love her. [image: a photo of a snake in a tank with sand and plants]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: What was it like when you found her? I can imagine the relief!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Seeing her snuggled under the bed made me feel so much love and gratitude. It made me realize how important she is to me.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: They bring so much joy and remind us of what's important.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Animals teach us a lot about love and gratitude, and they bring so much joy.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I haven't introduced you to my pets yet! I don't like dogs, that's why I have cats. [image: a photography of two cats sitting on a couch with a blanket]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Looks like they're having a blast! How often do you take them out?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Exercise and nature are really important to me, so I make sure to take them out for a run in the park every morning and evening. [image: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow Deb, that's great! I'd love to experience that every day.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Nature helps me find peace every day - it's so refreshing!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It's a pity that my snakes don't run!  I'd love to do that more often. They would motivate me and together it would be more fun. [image: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's like hitting a reset button that helps me put things into perspective and gives me time to reflect.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yeah, I totally get it. Whenever I can, I love going for walks to take it all in. And I take photos like this [image: a photo of a sunset over a body of water]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's amazing how nature has the power to bring us peace and clarity.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: This photo captures the peacefulness of a lake surrounded by trees. [image: a photo of a dock on a lake with trees in the background]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Why did you choose that spot? It looks so calm.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It's such a hidden gem! It makes me feel so peaceful and tranquil.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Lucky you for having somewhere to relax and tune out!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: We'll definitely go there together sometime!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: We all need a timeout!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hey Jolene! Great news - I just started a project for a cleanup in our community and have been trying to raise funds for it. It's been amazing to see everyone come together to make a difference. How've you been? Anything new going on?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hey Debs! Congrats on your project for the community! As for me, life's been a rollercoaster lately. Last week, I had a huge setback with my project. I put in so much work and it all crashed and I lost everything. SO frustrating and depressing.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Jolene, sorry to hear that. It must be really tough. I'm here for you and if I can do anything, just let me know. Is there anything that's helping you cope?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Your support means a lot. Susie really helps when times get tough. Pets have been great company. Video games have also been a nice distraction. [image: a photo of a man holding a snake on his arm]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: They can really provide love and comfort, especially during tough times. How did you come to have Susie?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I adopted her two years ago when I was feeling lonely and wanted some company.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: That's great, Jolene! Animals sure have a way of bringing us happiness. They understand us and provide us with comfort. Plus, having a pet teaches us responsibility. She came at the perfect time - cherish those moments with her and find strength in her presence.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks Deborah. Having her around shows me I can stay strong and find joy in the small stuff.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Enjoying the little things is key. Those little moments can give us a boost and push us forward. How have you been taking care of yourself lately?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm trying to prioritize self-care, like yoga and meditation. It helps me stay balanced and grounded.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: If you're interested, I can suggest some routines for you to try.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm always on the lookout for new routines to mix things up.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: In the meantime, check out this great place for yoga. [image: a photo of a room with a lot of yoga mats on the floor]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: This room looks perfect for it. Do you have any favorite routines you can share?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: One of my favorite yoga routines is a gentle flow that's all about breathing and grounding. It helps me find my chill. I'll send you a tutorial video with the poses. This is me in the process :) [image: a photo of a woman in a pink shirt doing a yoga pose]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow! Does that help you find your chill or improve your concentration?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's a great way to find balance in tough times. Try it out and let me know what you think!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Can't wait to try it out. Let's chat soon!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Let me know how it goes. Talk to you later!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yep, I'll practice and update you. Bye!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Since we last spoke, I made a meditation guide for my yoga retreat. How about you?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I have been stressed since I lost my work files. I was so overwhelmed...but meditation kept me chill and I got my clarity back, thank goodness. Really appreciate the practice!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's amazing how it can give you peace and calm in times like that. If you ever need any support, just let me know - we're in this together!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Appreciate your support! BTW, I wanted to share this with you. [image: a photo of two notebooks with a blue cover and a white strip]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Your creativity is amazing!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deb! I was inspired by my love for space and engines, so I designed these notebooks with elements like galaxies and circuitry. I think they turned out really cool!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: You have such a knack for turning these into art. They make me feel excited just by looking at them. Your creativity is amazing! Does that usually inspire your engineering projects too?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Seeing art and design in various things gives me a unique perspective on problems.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Got any neat projects or ideas you're pumped about?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Working on a cool project now - a prototype that could revolutionize aerial surveillance. Can't wait to see the results!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I admire your ambition to make a difference. Do you have any specific plans or goals for this project?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: My aim is to devise a more productive and affordable aerial surveillance system. It'll help with responding to emergencies and monitoring the environment. It'll make the world a better, safer place.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I love your commitment. Keep going!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deb! Your support means a lot. I'll keep pushing and doing my best to make a difference.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: You got this!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Been thinking a lot about my plans lately, especially after checking in with my bf. It's been up and down!  Some days it feels like I'm trying to juggle my engineering, relationship, and growing as a person, and I just don't know how to handle it all. How do you manage when it's too much? [image: a photo of a book with a checklist on it]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Finding ways to restore balance is important. Taking time for yourself and recognizing your needs can make a difference. [image: a photo of a room with a moss wall and a floor cushion]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deb! I've been trying out some time management strategies recently and started using a bullet journal. It's been really helpful for tracking my tasks and staying organized.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's great to hear that it's been helping you out!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Not only does it help me stay on top of everything, but it's also so satisfying when I cross tasks off my list. Here's a pic of my newest spread with one of my favorite quotes. [image: a photo of a notebook with a quote on it]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I love this quote. So uplifting. Does it motivate you when you see it?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yeah, it's like a little reminder to stick to my goals and never give up.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Gotcha! Visual reminders like this photo can be super motivating. Keep focusing on your goals, Jolene, and don't give up! I led a meditation yoga sessionto the elderly at a local care home last week during sunset. Nature can be really helpful for finding peace. Have you tried mindfulness too? [image: a photo of a group of people doing yoga on a beach]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Haven't tried it yet, but I'm keen to give it a shot. That sounds really peaceful. I could use some of that calm in my life right now.  I'm interested in destressing and trying mindfulness.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I started with workshops and books, and now mindfulness is a huge part of my life.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'll definitely look into some of it. Can't wait to get started!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: That's great, Jolene! I'm so glad you're willing to try some mindfulness. It can be really helpful. Let me know if you need any help getting started - I'm happy to assist you with your journey!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I really appreciate it.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: We're in this together. Give me a shout if you need anything. Bye for now.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, I'll hit you up if I need anything. Bye for now.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Hey Jolene! Hope you're having a good one. Last Friday I told Anna the story of my life and they were super kind about it. It was so nice to have a meaningful connection. How's the mindfulness workshops and reading going? Need any help?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Life's been hella busy since we last talked. I bought a console for my partner as a gift on the 17th and it's so much fun, he even managed to play it.! Engineering studies are still going strong too. Balance has been key for me lately. How about you? What's been up? [image: a photo of a black xbox console with a yoda yoda figure next to it]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Well done! As for me, I've been focusing on teaching yoga and spending time with the community. Organizing a yoga event last month was really cool.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Was it rewarding seeing everyone come together? Can you tell me more about how you put it together? Also, any tips for maintaining a balance between hobbies and studies?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I reached out to different nearby businesses and places to make it happen. We had yoga, food stalls, and even some live music - it was amazing! As for balancing hobbies and studies, I find it helpful to prioritize and manage my time effectively. Making a schedule and setting aside specific time for studying and pursuing hobbies can go a long way in maintaining balance.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow, that's awesome! Gonna make a plan to manage my studies and hobbies. Say, do you ever play video games?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I used to play some video games, but it's been a while. It's a good way to relax after a busy day. Do you have any game suggestions? What's your favorite game?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I have a few game recommendations. Zelda BOTW for Switch is an awesome open-world game. Animal Crossing: New Horizons is really calming and cute. As for my favorite game, it's hard to choose just one!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Cool recs! I'll definitely check those out. What about your favorite memories of playing video games? [image: a photo of a man and a woman sitting in a chair in front of a computer]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Oh, I forgot to mention Overcooked 2 - this is a good co-op game if you're into hilarious and chaotic cooking. My partner and I often play for bets! I once won three large pizzas!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Reminds me of when I used to play games with my husband. We'd take turns and it was a great way to bond and make memories. Gaming really can bring people closer, right?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yeah, you`re right! What's your favorite game to play with that person?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: We prefer to play detective games together.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: What other activities do you both enjoy doing together?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: We also enjoyed spending time outdoors and exploring nature. It was always so refreshing to be outside and soak up the fresh air.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm a big fan of being outside too! It's so calming and refreshing. Do you have any special spots you like to go to?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I love going to this park near my house - it has a nice forest trail and a beach. It's a peaceful spot where I can do some yoga and reflect. There's also a special bench that holds special meaning to me.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Sounds lovely! Nature can be calming. What makes this bench special to you? [image: a photo of a bench in a park with a tree in the background]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It holds a lot of special memories for me and my mom - we would come here and chat about dreams and life. It's full of good moments. [image: a photo of a person sitting on a bench in a forest]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: That's awesome, Deborah! What were some of your favorite memories with your mom at this spot? It looks super peaceful and pretty.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I'll always cherish my memories with her at this spot. I remember a beautiful sunset we watched together in silence - the colors in the sky were so special. Every time I go back, I feel so much peace and gratitude for the time I spent with her.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Places and moments like that can mean so much, and it's a gift to find peace and gratitude in them.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I'm really thankful for all the time we had.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It's so important to cherish it.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Long time no talk! We were given a new game for the console last week, it is Battlefield 1. What's been up with you?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you. That`s cool! Been thinking about a few big moments lately - went to a place that held a lot of memories for me. Sat on a bench where we used to chat and it brought back a lot of emotions. [image: a photo of a flower cart on a sidewalk with flowers in it]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Mostly happy or a bit of everything?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It was quite a mix, Jolene. I felt nostalgia and longing, but also grateful for the memories. It's amazing how a place can mean so much. I brought these flowers there. [image: a photo of a vase of flowers on the ground in a street]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Do you think she would like it?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Yeah, my mom really loved flowers. They always made her so happy. She appreciated the simple things in life. [image: a photo of a woman holding a bouquet of red roses]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow, that's a great photo! How did she show you to appreciate it?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: By taking it slow, seeing beauty in them, and finding joy.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow Deb, that's awesome! We should definitely take time to enjoy that and not let the business of life cause us to miss out on the good stuff.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Yeah, Jolene. Life can be so busy that we often overlook the small things that truly matter. Let's make an effort to appreciate them more.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yep Deb, slowing down and enjoying simple moments can bring a lot of balance and happiness. I'm trying to do more yoga and meditation myself to help relax and stay focused. Are there any calming habits that you practice to feel balanced?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Yeah, same here, Jolene! Yoga and meditation help me find balance and inner peace. Going out for walks and staying mindful also keep me grounded. I take similar photos on walks. [image: a photo of a sunset over a body of water]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Gorgeous! Going for a walk and feeling so peaceful must be amazing.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Moments like that I'll always cherish.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: That calm and peaceful feeling is so nice - it's great for recharging and thinking.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's like a reboot for me.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Got it! It's like hitting the refresh button and coming back even better. [image: a photo of a green cushion on a floor in front of a window]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: What's your favorite yoga pose for some rest?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm a fan of savasana - aka the corpse pose. It's so calming and helps me just let go and surrender. [image: a photo of a person laying on the floor with a paper bag]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Funny photo! How long have you been doing yoga?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Been doing it for 3 years. It's a great way to escape studying and work stress.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Wow, Jolene! Taking time to unwind is key and that seems just right for you!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm really finding my zen again!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Keep it up!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks for your support, Deb!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Good luck with everything. Stay in touch.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you! A lot's happened since we talked - last week I got to go to this yoga retreat near my mom's place. It was so cool - I got to hang with nature and really get to know myself. Definitely life-changing! That's how beautiful it was there! [image: a photo of a trail in a forest with moss and trees]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow, Deb, sounds great! Glad you got to connect with yourself and nature. That's my own way to relax. What are your thoughts on life now? [image: a photo of a man bending over on a blanket in the grass]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Life's been super meaningful lately. Nature and self-reflection have helped me see how beautiful every moment is. We can really grow and learn when we listen to ourselves. What's been up with you lately? Any insights or experiences? [image: a photo of a mountain range with a colorful sunset in the background]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Life's been hectic, but I'm making strides toward my goals. It's tough, but satisfying.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Can you tell me a bit more about it and what you've achieved?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: My goal is to be successful in my field and make a positive impact. I've been studying, attending workshops, and networking to make it happen. Recently, I had the opportunity to present at a virtual conference and received positive feedback.  It was a great experience and confirmed that I'm on the right track.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: You really put your heart and soul into it. Must have been amazing having it go so well. How did it feel when people gave you positive feedback? Any ideas for what comes next?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I was thrilled to receive such positive feedback! It felt so rewarding to know that my efforts were appreciated. Right now, I'm focusing on studying and gaining more experience. I'm even thinking about more internships to further enhance my skills. Exciting times! Hopefully, there will be more updates to share with you soon.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Wow, Jolene! Way to go! I'm super proud of all you've achieved. Let me know if you need any help. Onward!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deb! Your support means a lot to me.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: No problem. You got this!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm not giving up, just gonna keep pushing forward.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Reach for your goals and don't forget to enjoy the journey.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deb. Your support means a lot. I'll keep pushing forward and remember to enjoy every step of the way.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Come on! The journey's as important as the destination. Take time for yourself and find joy in it. We believe in you! [image: a photo of a field of sunflowers with a sunset in the background]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yeah, you're right! I'll take your advice and find joy on the way. Cheers for the support! [image: a photo of a city skyline at sunset with a body of water]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Always by your side!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Hey Jolene, since we talked I've been thinking about my mom's influence. Remembering those we love is important.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I understand, Deb. Remembering and cherishing the memories of our loved ones is so important. It's comforting to know that their influence still guides us. Last Friday, my partner and I talked about how our loved ones have influenced us and what their values meant to us. It was an emotional chat, but it made us feel closer and showed us what really matters.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Those types of conversations really help build relationships. Can you tell me more about the values they have given you?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Definitely! Our loved ones have taught us to persevere and stay resilient, like my mom always said to never give up, and my partner's dad showed them to stay determined. Their values have influenced us to pursue our goals, such as me with engineering and my partner with their creative endeavors. Even though they're not here, we both feel their values encouraging us along our paths.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: That's wonderful to hear, Jolene! It's amazing how their values continue to guide you, even in their absence. It sounds like you and your partner are honoring their memory by pursuing your respective passions. Have you ever considered incorporating those values into your work as well?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yeah, Deborah! We've been figuring out how to add these values into our projects. As an engineering student, I want to use my talents to do good and help solve important problems. I'm keen on coming up with new ideas and making things more efficient to make the world a better place. Going further, my mom stressed the value of helping others and that's something I want to keep in mind for my engineering projects.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: When our work ties into our values, it becomes more meaningful. What goals or ideas do you have for incorporating those values into your future projects?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: In the future, I'm aiming to work on projects that make a real difference to communities. I'm interested in sustainable initiatives and developing innovative solutions for environmental issues. I also want to get involved with organizations that focus on social causes, using my skills to help out. It's about connecting my passion for engineering with my commitment to making a positive impact.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: You've got a lot of amazing plans for the future. Which projects are you most interested in getting involved in?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm keen on two projects in particular. One is focused on developing renewable energy, like solar, to help communities and reduce dependence on non-renewables.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Wow Jolene, that's really inspiring!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: The other is finding ways to supply clean water to those with limited access. Both align with my beliefs about sustainability and assisting those in need. I still have so much to figure out before beginning, but I'm up for the challenge.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Sounds great, Jolene! Research is key to success. Little steps and being up for challenges make you stronger. I'm here for you. Connecting to yourself helps tackle any issue. Here's a photo that reminds me of the beauty of nature during a yoga session. [image: a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It helps with challenges, giving balance and strength. Any tips for staying relaxed while studying?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Taking breaks, doing some stretching/yoga, or just going for a walk is really helpful. And don't forget to get enough sleep and take time for self-care. Finding a balance between work and taking care of yourself is important. What self-care activities have you been doing lately?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I've been into yoga and meditation lately. It helps me recharge. Doing different poses relieves tension and calms my mind. I've already shared my newfound love for yoga with my partner, and we're planning to go on a meditation retreat together to enhance our practice together. [image: a photo of a woman in a pink shirt doing a yoga pose]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Glad to hear that yoga is helping you rest and recharge. It's great for reflection and self-care. Do your snakes also enjoy it?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: My snakes just like watching me chill. But she's a great company and always brings a sense of calm.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Having a pet around is such a calming feeling. They sure can bring a great sense of comfort. I still have cats, Luna is sitting on the left. [image: a photo of two cats sitting on a window sill looking out]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Aww, that's adorable! What's the second one's name?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Max! They bring lots of joy and peace to our home. [image: a photo of a brown leather chair and a black and white floor]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: How did you get them?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Max is my mother's cat, I took him when my mother passed away. [image: a photo of a car with a fan and a mesh bag]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: You're great for taming him. How did you get Luna?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I took Luna from the shelter.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It’s wonderful that you have become their loving owner!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Yes, I really love cats, and they also need a home, love, and care! Moreover, Max is already old, he is 8 years old.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: How old is Luna?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: She is younger, she is 5 years old.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I am proud of your action to tame these pets!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Hey Deborah, how's it going? Guess what? Yesterday my partner and I got back from an awesome trip to Rio de Janeiro- we checked out some cool yoga classes. [image: a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose in a mirror]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: That yoga pose looks great. Must've been a cool experience for the two of you. What did the trip teach you?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: This country was awesome! It showed me different kinds of yoga and their backgrounds, which made me appreciate it even more. We visited a lot of delicious cafes! Have you ever been somewhere that was important to you?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Yep, last month I visited my mom`s house which holds a special place in my heart. My mom had good and bad times there, but it's still a symbol of her strength and the love she shared with me. This is my husband in front of this house. [image: a photo of a man standing in front of a house]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: What was it like?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It brought back fond memories as I relaxed outside.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Sounds great! So glad you have a place to relax and find peace.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Thanks, Jolene. It's special for me. How about you? Is there a place that helps you relax?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I go to this nearby place to meditate by a tranquil spot. [image: a photo of a pond with lily pads and a tree in the background]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Looks chill. What's been the effect of that?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It helps me make sense of everything and relieves stress. It's like a restart.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Cool, glad you found a place to chill. We all need that occasionally. This is one of my favorite spots to ponder and let things go. [image: a photo of a lake with a few trees in the water]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Looks great! What made you pick that spot?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: The soothing vibes and nice views made it ideal for reflecting and letting go.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Here is one more photo from Rio de Janeiro. We went on many excursions there. [image: a photo of a group of people walking up a set of stairs]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Wow, those stairs look cool! Where were they taken?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Good luck with it! Let me know if there's anything I can do to assist you.

memories.content: That`s awesome! It looks so calm in the pic - I hope you enjoy your experience and learn some new techniques!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It's amazing how something so easy can make such a big difference to our health!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Yep, it's become part of my routine now. Can't imagine my life without it.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yeah, same! It helps me stay balanced during my studies.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Glad to hear it, Jolene. How's the project going?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It's tough but I'm chugging along. Thanks!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: You're so strong for handling all the challenges. You've got this!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deb! Your support really means a lot. I'll keep pushing forward.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: No worries, Jolene. I'm here if you need me. Take care of yourself and don't forget to rest up.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Did my photo remind you of something?

memories.content: Glad it brought back good memories.

memories.content: Sorry to hear about it. How are you feeling now?

memories.content: I was bummed about it, but I'm doing better now. It was just a setback, but I found comfort in my work and spending time at home. Reminds me to be grateful for the little things. And you? How's it going?

memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Having a routine helps me stay on top of everything I need to do. I have a schedule for classes, studying, and personal time. Self-care activities like yoga and meditation help me stay balanced and relax.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I'd love to learn more about how you do it.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I can tell you about it if you're interested. It took a bit of experimenting, but it's really helped me.

memories.content: Sounds good, Jolene! When did you have in mind? That cafe rocks.

memories.content: How about Wednesday at 4? Can't wait to catch up over coffee! [image: a photo of a person holding a cup of coffee in front of a bunch of flowers]

memories.content: That pic looks so peaceful. Reminded me of a cool hidden coffee shop near me. Rate it! [image: a photo of a group of people sitting at tables in a room]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Tell me more about it when we meet, maybe next time we’ll be there.

Nature, reflection and a break from engineering studies were awesome - it helped me find inner peace. [image: a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on the beach]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I'd love to hear more about your reflections there and how they changed you.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: At the retreat, I had time to reflect on what makes me happy. It made me realize the importance of incorporating relaxation, self-care, and balance in life alongside my engineering studies. The beauty of nature there was so inspiring and refreshing!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Was there anything from the retreat that stood out to you?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: The one session that really stood out was about releasing expectations and judgments and just savoring the present. It was a strong reminder to not just dwell on the finish line, but to appreciate the journey too. I usually get too consumed with hitting my goals that I forget to appreciate the ride.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: I've been thinking about this a lot, too. Life's full of small moments and being grateful for those can really boost our happiness.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yup, totally agree! Sometimes we get too focused on the big stuff and don't appreciate all the tiny wins. Like the feeling of the sun or a great cup of coffee - can be small but they make life much better. Trying to be more mindful and grateful to take it all in now.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: That's great, Jolene! Practicing mindfulness and gratitude can really change our day-to-day. Even just a different outlook can make the little things in life joyful. Glad you're getting into it!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I'm experiencing a new level of joy and happiness!
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's wonderful to see your progress, and I'm excited to be on this journey with you!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deb! Appreciate your support. It's great that we can do this together.
memories.speaker: Jolene

[image: a photo of two children standing on yoga mats in a room]

memories.content: I look forward to meeting you and playing this game!

memories.content: It's great that you could reconnect with them. Hearing stories about our loved ones can be tough but also comforting.

memories.content: It can bring up a range of emotions, and it's okay to feel a mix of happiness and sadness. Those moments with her friends must've been meaningful to you.

memories.content: That looks like a blast! What did you and your mom's friends do on that day?

memories.content: Looking at old photos must have been so nostalgic! It's great that you could share that experience with friends. It's amazing how photos and memories can give us a deeper appreciation for the people we love.

memories.content: Wow, what a gorgeous pic! Do you have any special memories of that beach or just love surfing in general?

memories.content: What pleasant memories.

memories.content: Oh, same for me!

memories.content: I find calm when I do yoga or meditate. I use essential oils and put on some soft, soothing music in the background to create a peaceful atmosphere. It really helps me chill out and center myself.

memories.content: It's amazing how our environment can enhance our practice.

memories.content: Yeah, totally! Our surroundings can really affect our mood and how much zen we can get from our routine. Creating a place that feels safe and chill is key. [image: a photo of a bed with a colorful blanket and pillows]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Wow, that looks so comfy and inviting! Where do you usually go to relax in your house?

memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Let's plan for next month - I'll check my schedule and let you know. Can't wait!

memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Wow, festivals sound so fun! Here's me and my partner at one last year - had an awesome time! It's my way of expressing myself and getting away from all the stress of everyday life. memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Wow, what a gorgeous shot! It looks so tranquil and serene. You two look very happy together. Trips create awesome memories that we can share. Where did you go on your trip and what's something you'll never forget?

memories.content: Thanks! We had an awesome yoga retreat. The place was so peaceful and the view during yoga was amazing - the sunrise lit up the whole sky with bright colors. It was so beautiful, it made us feel so alive and grateful. [image: a photo of a sunset over a valley with a horse]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Wow, what a view!  How did it make you feel?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: It was amazing! Doing yoga with that backdrop made me feel connected to nature and myself. I felt incredibly peaceful and thankful.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Like, it's no wonder looking at such beauty can really help us refocus and connect with who we are. Have you ever experienced that?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: I remember taking a hike with my partner and coming across a waterfall oasis. Everything just felt so peaceful and my worries just disappeared. It was such a refreshing experience.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: Are you planning to experience it again soon?
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Yeah! I'm planning to get out in nature again next month. It's going to be great reconnecting with it!

memories.content: Enjoy it! This photo made me think of a gorgeous blossom tree from near my home. Every spring, it was magical to watch it bloom. [image: a photo of a pink flowered tree with a blue sky in the background]
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: That sounds magical! How was it watching the tree bloom each spring?
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It was like admiring nature's artwork. It filled me with awe and made me appreciate the beauty of life. Even in tough times, there's hope for growth.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: This photo I took is a great visual representation of that idea. It reminds me that I can keep growing through any obstacles. [image: a photo of a plant growing out of a corner of a building]
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It really captures resilience and strength. I love how you find inspiration in the small things.
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Thanks, Deborah! Appreciating those small things is important. It helps me remember that even when times are tough, there's always something positive to hang onto.
memories.speaker: Jolene

memories.content: It's a great habit. Thanks for reminding me!
memories.speaker: Deborah

memories.content: Sure Deb, it's great catching up. Keep on finding those beauties!
